column1: # Builder calls replayed by both test kits (spec §4.12, golden test).
# golden/<doc>.pdf and golden/widths.tsv) and by tests/python/test_testing.py
# (pdf_extract.testing), which compares its own bytes and widths with those
# files. One script for both sides means the two can only differ through the
# builders. Numbers are decimal strings: both sides parse them to f64 and
# narrow to f32, which is exactly what the Python binding does with a float.
# Tab-separated; the text is always the last field and may contain spaces
# (but no tab or newline). Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#   doc    NAME                          start a new document
#   text   X Y FONTSIZE MODE TEXT        insert_text on the latest page
#   width  FONTSIZE TEXT                 text_width, compared bit for bit
